messages.author: e952a7abee5394d8
messages.subject: Leaflet Package
parts:
Hello,

I'm designing a web application in which I need an interactive map which can return the latitude and longitude coordinates of a spot on the map when clicked. Leaflet seems to be ideal for this application as it already has built in methods to do that. However when I try to install the leaflet or rCharts package(using install.packages("leaflet") ) I get an error message that the package is not compatible with R 3.0.2:

Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘leaflet’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

Am I installing the wrong package, or is leaflet really not available for this version of R?

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Leaflet Package
parts:
Both rCharts and Leaflet-Shiny need to be installed from github, using the devtools package

library(devtools)
install_github("leaflet-shiny", "jcheng5")
install_github("rCharts", "ramnathv", ref = "dev")
